title: MuEdit: An efficient multi-task editing method towards inter-domain knowledge conflicts
abstract: arXiv:2611.14910v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) require frequent knowledge updates across heterogeneous domains, but existing editing methods fail when applied sequentially to multi-task settings. We trace this collapse to inter-domain null-space misalignment: heterogeneous tasks induce distinct Jacobian geometries, causing their common null space to shrink dramatically and leaving insufficient admissible directions for conflict-free updates. We propose the Conflict Index to quantify this geometric interference, and introduce Mu-Edit, which mitigates multi-task conflicts via (1) conflict-aware ordering to minimize cumulative interference, and (2) dynamic low-rank approximation to expand the null space when ordering alone is insufficient. translated_title: MuEdit：一种面向跨域知识冲突的高效多任务编辑方法
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）需要在异构领域之间进行频繁的知识更新，但现有的编辑方法在多任务设置下顺序应用时会失效。我们将这种失效归因于跨域零空间失配：异构任务会诱导出不同的雅可比几何结构，导致它们的公共零空间急剧收缩，从而没有足够的可容许方向来实现无冲突更新。我们提出冲突指数（Conflict Index）来量化这种几何干扰，并引入MuEdit，通过以下两种方式缓解多任务冲突：（1）冲突感知的任务排序，以最小化累积干扰；（2）当仅靠排序不足时，采用动态低秩近似来扩展零空间。在五个功能领域和三个骨干模型上的实验表明，MuEdit在多任务编辑性能上显著优于现有基线方法，同时保持了通用能力，并且仍然有效（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出MuEdit方法，通过冲突感知的任务排序和动态低秩近似解决多任务知识编辑中跨域零空间失配导致的冲突问题，在保持模型通用能力的同时显著提升多任务编辑性能。
en_tdlr: MuEdit tackles multi-task knowledge editing failures caused by inter-domain null-space misalignment through conflict-aware task ordering and dynamic low-rank approximation, significantly outperforming existing baselines while preserving general capabilities.
